jobs.description:
**Job Function** Business Strategy, Payments, Programming, Analysis and Technical Support, Technology and Product, Customer Success Springfield, MO **Additional Location** Allen, Texas; Charlotte, North Carolina; Lenexa, Kansas; Louisville, Kentucky; Monett, Missouri; Springfield, Missouri; Troy, Michigan **Workplace Type** Hybrid **Travel** 5% **Date posted** 09/09/2026 **Job ID** 17392
 Save


At Jack Henry, we’re more than a technology company, we’re a force for good in financial services. We’re redefining how community banks and credit unions connect with the people they serve. Our mission is rooted in people inspired innovation, empowering financial institutions to deliver seamless, secure, and human centered experiences. We deliver cutting\-edge solutions that are paving the way for the next generation of digital banking and payments, but our true impact begins with our associates. If you're ready to help transform an industry and grow with a company that values purpose, collaboration, and excellence then we’d love to meet you.


The Implementation Coordinator acts as a liaison between the customer, assigned manager and the installation teams to ensure successful completion of implementations.


This is a remote position and candidates must live within approximately a 70\-mile radius of our office locations in Allen, TX; Lenexa, KS; Springfield, MO; or Monett, MO; Louisville, KY; Troy, MI; Charlotte, NC.


**What you’ll be responsible for:**


* Serves as a leader and resource for the installation team members.
* Prepares customer for implementation. Conducts readiness reviews, ensuring all aspects of setup are complete.
* Establishes guidelines/time\-frames to ensure a successful installation. Ensures milestones are met. Monitors all phases of the installation and escalates issues when necessary. May interact with project manager.
* Exercises the responsibility and authority to take steps to ensure a successful installation.
* Troubleshoots issues once implementation is complete.
* Conducts exit reviews. Documents issues, ensuring they are not repeated in subsequent conversions.
* Contributes to process and/or product improvements.
* Acts as an escalation point to other team members, when necessary.
* May train installation team personnel. May reinforce training to customers and/or provide guidance in training customer personnel.
* May participate in new release activities.
* May identify items that are outside the scope of a standard installation and participate in project activities related to those items.
* May participate in sales turnover meetings to schedule and determine the scope of the project.
* May assist less experienced peers.
* May perform other duties as assigned.
**What you’ll need to have:**


* Minimum of 3 years of experience in a financial institution or FinTech company.
* Minimum of 3 years of debit card experience (for example \- new accounts, switch blocks, limits, disputes, conversions)
**What would be nice for you to have:**


* Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree preferred.
* Excellent knowledge of the financial industry.
* Excellent knowledge of JH products.
* Strong communication and customer interaction skills.
* Strong organizational and time management skills.
* Able to act as a team lead and oversee complex implementations.
* Able to meet deadlines.
* Proficient in using MS Word, MS Excel, and SharePoint. May require proficiency with Visio.
* May require the ability to identify and resolve complex error messages.
If you got this far, we hope you're feeling excited about this opportunity. Even if you don't feel you meet every single requirement on this posting, we still encourage you to apply. We’re looking for passionate, driven individuals who align with our mission and can bring unique perspectives to our team.


**Why Jack Henry?**


At Jack Henry, we live by the motto: “*Do the right thing, do whatever it takes, and have fun.”* It’s more than a tagline, it’s the foundation of our culture. We recognize that our associates are the key to our success, and we’re deeply committed to their wellbeing. That’s why we offer comprehensive benefits designed to support your physical, mental, and financial health so you can thrive both personally and professionally.


We’re also leading the way in technology modernization, helping financial institutions evolve with speed, security, and flexibility. Our strategy focuses on delivering secure data access, mitigating fraud, and enabling seamless integration. Empowering our teams to build innovative solutions that meet the evolving needs of accountholders.


**Culture of Commitment**


Ask our associates why they love Jack Henry, and many will tell you it is because our culture is exceptional. We do great things together. Our culture empowers us to rise to challenges, seek new opportunities, and support one another through change. It’s this shared commitment that drives our success. We’re proud to foster an environment where inclusion, sustainability, and community impact are more than values, they’re how we operate. Visit our Corporate Sustainability (opens in new window) site to learn more about our culture and commitment to our people, customers, community, environment, and shareholders.


**Equal Employment Opportunity**


At Jack Henry, we know we are better together. We value, respect, and protect the uniqueness each of us brings. Innovation flourishes by including all voices and makes our business \- and our society \- stronger. Jack Henry is an equal opportunity employer and we are committed to providing equal opportunity in all of our employment practices, including selection, hiring, performance management, promotion, transfer, compensation, benefits, education, training, social, and recreational activities to all persons regardless of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, genetic information, pregnancy, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, and military and veteran status, or any other protected status protected by local, state or federal law.

jobs.title: Customer Onboarding Specialist - Associate
jobs.description:
Established in 2021, **Independence Pet Holdings** is a corporate holding company that manages a diverse and broad portfolio of modern pet health brands and services, including insurance, pet education, lost recovery services, and more throughout North America.

  

We believe pet insurance is more than a financial product and build solutions to simplify the pet parenting journey and help improve the well\-being of pets. As a leading authority in the pet category, we operate with a full stack of resources, capital, and services to support pet parents. Our multi\-brand and omni\-channel approach include our own insurance carrier, insurance brands and partner brands.

**Job Summary:**

 **PetPartners Inc.** is seeking a **Customer Onboarding Specialist\- Associate** who will report to the Manager, Operations Business Processes. The Customer Onboarding Specialist\- Associate is responsible for ensuring a seamless onboarding experience for new and renewing group insurance clients, driving operational excellence and client satisfaction across all lines of business. The ideal candidate will bring insurance\-specific expertise and experience in group implementation, benefit configuration, and partner communications.


This individual will serve as a cross\-functional liaison between clients, technology partners, producers, and internal stakeholders to manage the end\-to\-end onboarding and implementation process for group pet insurance and employer\-sponsored offerings.

**Job Location:** Remote – USA

**Main Responsibilities:**

* **Lead complex onboarding initiatives** for employer group customers, including new business and renewals.
* **Own the end\-to\-end implementation process**—from intake to post\-launch support—ensuring a smooth transition into ongoing administration.
* Act as the primary point of contact for clients, producers, TPAs, and internal teams during onboarding.
* Configure **rates, benefit plan designs, commission structures, and eligibility rules** in internal administration platforms.
* Collaborate with Underwriting, Compliance, Legal, Product, and Technology teams to ensure all implementation elements meet regulatory and operational standards.
* Schedule and lead onboarding meetings, kickoff calls, and stakeholder reviews with internal and external contacts.
* Proactively monitor system performance and troubleshoot issues during onboarding and beyond.
* Support system testing, documentation, and training for new platform releases and enhancements.
* Contribute to process improvement efforts, identifying opportunities to streamline implementation workflows and improve customer experience.
* Serve as a subject matter expert for group onboarding within the insurance vertical.
* Provide mentorship and informal guidance to junior onboarding specialists.
* Additional duties and special projects as assigned.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* **2\+ years of experience** in insurance operations, customer onboarding, or implementation roles
* Proven experience managing B2B client relationships
* Deep understanding of insurance product setup, enrollment, and eligibility processes.
* Excellent communication and strong time management skills with demonstrated ability to manage multiple complex onboarding projects.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint); experience with policy admin systems or CRM tools preferred.
* High attention to detail, analytical mindset, and the ability to work independently in a remote environment.
* **Internal Candidates must have working knowledge of OnePack Plan and the PetPortal**

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience working with third\-party administrators, payroll platforms, or benefit enrollment systems.
* Familiarity with pet insurance or voluntary employee benefits is a plus.
* Experience with software testing and UAT processes.
* Ability to influence cross\-functional stakeholders and lead meetings with clients and executives.

**Expected Hours of Work:**

* This is a full\-time position: Days and hours to be determined by needs of business. Hours to be determined between employee and director


\#li\-Remote


All of our jobs come with great benefits including healthcare, parental leave and opportunities for career advancements. Some offerings are dependent upon the location of where you work and can include the following:

* Health Savings Account (HSA)

jobs.description:
R1 is the leading provider of technology\-driven solutions that transform the patient experience and financial performance of hospitals, health systems and medical groups. We are the one company that combines the deep expertise of a global workforce of revenue cycle professionals with the industry’s most advanced technology platform, encompassing sophisticated analytics, AI, intelligent automation, and workflow orchestration.


The Implementation Consultant I will oversee the deployment and implementation of the Entri Product Suite. They will engage with the client, hospital operations and applications/infrastructure teams to design, build, and implement the patient and user experience solutions. This position will also assist with upholding standard workflows and create educational materials to prepare for go lives. The Implementation Consultant I will be responsible to hold all stakeholders accountable in the delivery of the solution.


A successful candidate will exhibit the ability to lead a cross\-functional project to build and operationalize a business to consumer solution, be expected to identify subject matter experts to solve for potential obstacles, meet project deadlines and identify, escalate or resolve any issues that would impact the ability to deliver on the solution. They are expected to have strong communication skills to inform and engage key stakeholders across various levels with project updates and/or escalations. The Implementation Consultant I will propose new opportunities for efficiencies, enhancement, and expansion of product and process initiatives. This role is the entry level position into Configuration and Deployment and initially works on a limited product scope, with the opportunity and expectation to learn and progress quickly.


**Essential Responsibilities**

* Manages on\-time and competent delivery of application database build. Self\-motivation is critical to the success of this position.
* Provides support to the entire deployment team and actively communicates between all stakeholders.
* Consults with the client and project team to define and obtain the data necessary to build applications based on the scope of the contract and client needs, and within the timeline and budget.
* Uses a creative problem\-solving approach to analyze data along with workflow to determine standard best practice processes to gain efficiencies.
* Collaborates with the client, operations, training, IT and support team members to meet project timelines. Motivates stakeholders to execute operational change and achieve desired results.
* Ability to deliver clear and concise training, objectives, and expectations to end users, and collaborate with stakeholders to design educational materials.
* Leads the client in database validation and conducts functional and integrated testing to ensure readiness for successful go lives.
* Actively seeks to understand the challenges and needs in the health care industry, particularly in the patient access arena.

**Skills**

* Proficient computer skills (including, but not limited to, Microsoft Word, Excel, Power Point and Visio) are required.
* Highly organized, strong interpersonal skills and clear and concise oral and written communication skills.
* Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, clients, office staff, and peers.
* Strong problem solving, analytical and critical thinking skills.
* Results and deadline driven, working well under high pressure situations while staying resourceful, tactful, and adjust to rapidly changing needs from the customer.

* 2\+ years Healthcare/Technology experience.
* Understanding of HIPAA and importance of privacy of patient data.

jobs.title: Implementation Consultant - Path
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
===================

**WHO WE ARE**

Your members run lean. Your donors expect impact. Your staff is juggling a dozen systems to make it happen. At Momentive Software, we build the technology that makes that easier.  



  

We are the leading software platform for nonprofits and associations, serving more than 37,000 mission\-driven organizations for over 40 years. Our portfolio covers every core need: association management (MC Trade, NimbleAMS, YourMembership, WildApricot, and more), event management (A2Z Events), learning management (Path LMS), fundraising (GiveSmart), accounting (MIP Accounting), certification management, career centers, volunteer management, and community tools — connected through one ecosystem. MomentiveIQ, our AI layer, automates workflows, personalizes engagement, and surfaces insights across every product.  



  

We're remote\-first, inclusive by design, and serious about the work because our clients' missions are serious.  



  

**WHO WE NEED**

We're looking for an Implementation Consultant to join our Client Services team. You'll lead onboarding projects for new clients and deliver professional services consulting for existing ones. You combine the consultative instincts to guide an executive through a discovery session with the technical depth to configure a platform and validate that it works the way the client needs it to.  



  

This role sits at the intersection of project management, technical configuration, and client relationship\-building. You will work across our association management and learning management platforms, helping organizations go live, adopt best practices, and get full value from their investment.  



  

**WHO YOU ARE**

You're an experienced implementation professional who learns new platforms quickly and explains them clearly — to a technical administrator and to an executive director in the same week. You manage competing priorities without dropping details, hold timelines without losing relationships, and push for quality without waiting to be asked.  



  

You treat every client engagement as a consulting project: listen first, configure second, train third. You document what you build, share what you learn, and look for ways to make the next implementation better than the last.  



  

**HOW YOU WILL MAKE AN IMPACT**

**Lead Client Implementations**

* Own end\-to\-end onboarding projects from kickoff through go\-live, managing scope, timelines, milestones, and risks throughout.
* Set and maintain client expectations — communicating changes proactively, surfacing issues early, and keeping projects moving through shifting priorities.
* Hold clients and internal stakeholders accountable to agreed timelines without damaging the relationship.
* Navigate changing requirements while maintaining project momentum and delivering successful outcomes.

**Configure and Deliver Solutions**

Conduct discovery to understand each client's business processes, then translate those requirements into platform configurations that fit how they actually work.


* Configure application settings, workflows, and platform options to meet each client's functional and reporting needs.
* Support data imports and validate data setup to ensure a clean, accurate go\-live.
* Define, execute, and document testing to confirm client requirements are met before cutover.
* Troubleshoot and resolve configuration and system setup issues throughout the implementation lifecycle.

**Guide and Enable Client Teams**

* Help clients understand how to get the most from the platform by sharing best practices, recommending workflow approaches, and connecting their business processes to platform capabilities.
* Act as the primary point of guidance throughout the implementation — answering questions, clarifying how features apply to their specific context, and helping teams feel ready at go\-live.
* Build trusted relationships with stakeholders at every level, from day\-to\-day administrators to executive leadership.
* Serve as a trusted advisor: surface risks before they become problems, help clients make informed configuration decisions, and set them up for long\-term success.

**Strengthen the Team**

* Collaborate across Client Success, Support, Sales, and Product to deliver clean handoffs and consistent client experiences.
* Document client configurations, customizations, and key decisions so post\-implementation transitions are smooth.
* Help build and improve team assets — playbooks, templates, process guides — so our implementation practice gets more consistent and repeatable over time.

Share what you know: contribute to documentation, provide product feedback, and support teammates on the platforms and processes you know well.  

* 

  

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

**In Your First 90 Days**

Days 1–30: Get grounded.


* Complete onboarding on our platforms, internal systems, and implementation methodology.
* Shadow active client implementations to understand how we run projects end to end.
* Establish working relationships with cross\-functional partners in Client Success, Support, and Product.

Days 31–60: Start executing.


* Take ownership of straightforward implementation projects with support from the team.
* Begin managing client communications, configuration tasks, and project milestones independently on simpler engagements.
* Demonstrate proficiency in core platform configuration workflows and data setup processes.

Days 61–90: Build momentum.


* Carry a small active portfolio with increasing independence across project types.
* Identify at least one area where you can contribute to improving how the team works.

**At 6–12 Months**

* Independently manage a full client portfolio from kickoff through go\-live.
* Consistently meet or exceed client satisfaction (CSAT) targets at implementation close.
* Deliver implementations on or ahead of contracted timelines.
* Identify and resolve implementation risks before they escalate to client\-impacting issues.

Contribute at least one improvement to an existing team asset — a playbook, template, or process guide — that makes future implementations smoother.  

* 

  

**WHAT YOU BRING**

**Experience**

* 2–4 years of experience in SaaS implementation, technical consulting, or software delivery.
* Proven track record managing multiple concurrent implementation projects.
* Experience with Association Management Software (AMS), Learning Management Software (LMS), or similar nonprofit or membership platforms preferred.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, a technical field, or equivalent practical experience preferred.

**Technical Skills**

* Comfort configuring SaaS platforms — navigating admin settings, workflow tools, and configuration options to match client requirements.
* Experience supporting data imports and validating data accuracy prior to go\-live.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel for data analysis and validation.
* Experience with project or development management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or Trello.
* Comfort using AI tools to improve day\-to\-day work — whether for drafting communications, researching solutions, or finding faster ways to get things done.

**Professional Skills**

* Clear, direct written and verbal communication — including the ability to explain technical concepts to non\-technical audiences.
* Strong project management instincts: you prioritize well, track details, and keep work moving.
* Client\-first mindset with genuine investment in client outcomes, not just on\-time delivery.
* Comfortable working independently while collaborating closely across cross\-functional teams.
* Proactive approach to process improvement: you look for patterns, document what works, and share it.
* Project management certification (PMP, PMI\-ACP, or equivalent) is a plus.

**About Us**
============

Momentive Software amplifies the impact of over 20,000 purpose\-driven organizations in over 30 countries, with over $11 billion raised and 55 million members served to date. Mission\-driven nonprofits and associations rely on Momentive’s cloud\-based software and services to address their most pressing challenges – from engaging their communities to simplifying operations and growing revenue. Designed to help organizations connect more, manage more, and ultimately expect more, Momentive's solutions are built with reliability at the core and strategically focus on fundraising, learning, events, careers, volunteering, accounting, and association management. Momentive partners with organizations that believe "good enough" is never enough – so they can bring on better outcomes for everyone they serve. Learn more at momentivesoftware.com .  

  



**Why Work Here?**
==================

At Momentive Software, we’re a team of passionate problem\-solvers, innovators, and volunteers who believe in using technology to make a real difference. We dream big, support each other, and take pride in creating solutions that help our customers drive meaningful change. If you’re looking for a place where your work matters and your ideas are valued, you’ll find it here.


Medical, Dental \& Vision Benefits


401(k) Savings Plan with Company Match


Flexible Planned Paid Time Off


Generous Sick Leave


Inclusive \& Welcoming Environment


Purpose\-Driven Culture


Work\-Life Balance


Commitment to Community Involvement


Employer\-Paid Parental Leave


Employer\-Paid Short\-Term Disability


Remote Work Flexibility
  

  

Momentive Software actively embraces diversity and equal opportunity in a meaningful way. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, which is why we do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law.
  

  

All persons hired will be required to verify identity, minimum age of 18, eligibility to work in the United States (without sponsorship), and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire.

jobs.description:
Thank you for your interest in joining Solventum. Solventum is a new healthcare company with a long legacy of solving big challenges that improve lives and help healthcare professionals perform at their best. At Solventum, people are at the heart of every innovation we pursue. Guided by empathy, insight, and clinical intelligence, we collaborate with the best minds in healthcare to address our customers’ toughest challenges. While we continue updating the Solventum Careers Page and applicant materials, some documents may still reflect legacy branding. Please note that all listed roles are Solventum positions, and our Privacy Policy: https://www.solventum.com/en\-us/home/legal/website\-privacy\-statement/applicant\-privacy/ applies to any personal information you submit. As it was with 3M, at Solventum all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.
**Job Description:**

**Implementation Consultant** **(Solventum)**

**3M Health Care is now Solventum**

**At Solventum, we enable better, smarter, safer healthcare to improve lives. As a new company with a long legacy of creating breakthrough solutions for our customers’ toughest challenges, we pioneer game\-changing innovations at the intersection of health, material and data science that change patients' lives for the better while enabling healthcare professionals to perform at their best. Because people, and their wellbeing, are at the heart of every scientific advancement we pursue.**

**We partner closely with the brightest minds in healthcare to ensure that every solution we create melds the latest technology with compassion and empathy. Because at Solventum, we never stop solving for you.**

By applying to this position, you acknowledge that Solventum recently publicly announced its intention to divest its Health Information Systems Business. See Solventum Announces Intent to Separate its Health Information Systems Business :: Solventum Corporation Newsroom . No decision has been made regarding the ultimate structure or timing of any potential transaction, and there can be no assurance that a separation will occur. Any transaction would be subject to customary approvals, including approval by Solventum's Board of Directors, regulatory requirements and other customary conditions. This position supports the Health Information Systems Business. If a future transaction involving that business were to occur, the impact on this role would be determined as part of that process and would remain subject to applicable legal requirements, approvals and business decisions.


**The Impact You’ll Make in this Role**  

As an Implementation consultant, you will have the opportunity to tap into your curiosity and collaborate with some of the most innovative and diverse people around the world. Here, you will make an impact by:


* Collaborating with clients and internal team members to complete the project deliverables and implementation needs.
* Assessing current state workflow and work with implementation team to validate proposed future state fits with overall project objectives.
* Leading and working interactively with clients and team members to configure, test and validate the application environment.
* Leading issue resolution: communicating with client and internal teams on issue resolution and configuration change, tracking and documenting issues encountered.
* Performing problem isolation/analysis of issues, partner with support and escalations team in root cause analysis and troubleshooting.
* Training system administrators and end users
* Leading testing and go\-live support. Interacting with customer's team on issue resolution and configuration changes.
* Keeping up to date with all new features, functions, business issues and implementation options. And contributing to the evolutionary growth of implementation infrastructure by developing and/or updating material, tools and programs.

**Your Skills and Expertise**  

To set you up for success in this role from day one, Solventum requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications:


* Bachelor’s Degree or higher and three (3\) combined years direct experience with support of software and/or implementation of software (preferably in a healthcare setting)

OR


* High School Diploma/GED or higher from an accredited institution and 7 years combined years direct experience with support of software and/or implementation of software (preferably in a healthcare setting)

AND


In addition to the above requirements, the following are also required:


* Minimum of two (2\) combined years of working knowledge of hospital and/or professional healthcare coding workflow
* Minimum of two (2\) year' experience in a client facing implementation role
* Ability to travel
* Must be able to complete a Government background check for a position of T3 Public Trust

Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:


* Knowledge of 3M/Solventum HIS products
* Electronic Medical Record implementation experience
* Ability to solve problems in a logical, methodical, and time efficient manner
* Must be self\-starter with ability to analyze and critically think. Excellent problem solving and organizational skills.
* Strong written/verbal communication skills and must be capable of maintaining superior customer relations in a fast\-paced environment.
* Ability to quickly learn and apply new tools and technology

**Work location:**

* **Remote**

**Travel: May include up to 25%**

**Relocation Assistance: Not authorized**

Qualifications* Minimum 7 years of experience in healthcare onboarding, software implementation, or project coordination.

At Adoreal, we believe in supporting our team’s well\-being and growth through comprehensive benefits and a collaborative, people\-first culture. As a globally remote company, we prioritize flexibility, inclusivity, and teamwork rooted in the Adoreal principles.

**Benefits \& Perks:**

* **Healthcare coverage** for you and your family
* **Paid time off (PTO)** and **paid holidays**
* **Performance\-based bonuses** and **company equity opportunities**
* **Fully remote work environment** with flexible schedules
* **Collaborative and thriving team culture** guided by Adoreal’s core values


Why Adoreal?
Joining Adoreal means becoming part of a high\-performing, ambitious team that works hard, achieves extraordinary results, and enjoys the rewards that follow. Every employee receives equity, aligning us all in our shared success. Promotions and growth opportunities are limitless, driven only by your performance and dedication to our core principles:

  

* We do what is best for the company, not what is best for individuals of the company—we take pride in our work, but not in pride itself—the success of Adoreal is more important than our egos.

* We are quietly confident and openly humble, being tenacious in our quest to perform and inspire others with our thirst for excellence.
* We do not bow up and knock down—we care about our teammates and treat all of them with respect, regardless of their level within the company.
* We are steadfast in our pursuit to better our company, our colleagues, and ourselves. When we hire, we only hire people who bleed our principles and who will hopefully be our replacement one day.


At this time, Adoreal is not offering visa sponsorship for this position. Candidates must have current and valid authorization to work in the country where they are applying. Description:
**About Birdeye**


Birdeye is the leading agentic marketing platform for multi\-location brands.


Companies like H\&R Block, Aspen Dental, and Caesars Entertainment use Birdeye to manage marketing across thousands of locations — from how they get found, to how they convert, to how they retain customers. Our platform replaces disconnected point tools with AI agents that execute work at the location level — responding to reviews, updating listings, publishing content, and driving conversions.


Backed by Marc Benioff, Jerry Yang, and Accel\-KKR, Birdeye was named to G2’s 2026 Best Agentic AI Products list — appearing alongside the world’s leading AI companies. We’re expanding rapidly into enterprise, with growing adoption across large, multi\-location brands.

**About the Role**


We are looking for a customer\-focused Implementation Specialist to own the end\-to\-end deployment of Birdeye's AI and voice solutions. This role will work closely with customers, IT teams, FDEs, Product, and Engineering to configure, test, and launch solutions successfully.


This is a customer\-facing implementation and configuration role, not a backend engineering role.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own implementations from kickoff through go\-live, including timelines, milestones, risks, and customer communication.
* Execute integration playbooks and coordinate EHR/PMS and third\-party integrations.
* Configure providers, appointment types, availability, widgets, knowledge bases, and other product settings.
* Configure AI agents, including workflows, procedures, prompts, guardrails, and customer\-specific business rules.
* Be comfortable understanding customer requirements and translating them into effective agent workflows and experiences.
* Coordinate telephony setup and call\-forwarding with customer IT/telephony teams.
* Lead UAT, end\-to\-end testing, go\-live, and post\-launch validation.
* Identify risks and technical dependencies early and coordinate resolution with FDE/Engineering.
* Maintain accurate implementation documentation and continuously improve implementation playbooks.
* Voice Agent Tuning: Continuously tune voice agent workflows, prompts, procedures, and guardrails based on customer requirements, UAT results, and real\-world call behavior to improve accuracy and customer experience.
* Post\-Launch Call Reviews: Conduct regular post\-launch call reviews to identify gaps, incorrect responses, workflow issues, and opportunities to improve

**What This Role Does NOT Own**

* Backend tooling or custom backend logic
* Building or modifying APIs or engineering tools
* Custom engineering/SOW development
* Backend security/compliance logic
* Engineering\-level debugging of backend tooling


These requirements will be identified and coordinated with FDE/Engineering, while


Implementation owns the customer communication, testing, and delivery.


Requirements:
**Qualifications**

* 3–7 years of SaaS implementation, technical onboarding, professional services, or similar experience.
* Strong project management and customer\-facing communication skills.
* Comfortable with integrations, workflows, APIs, and technical concepts.
* Comfortable configuring AI/voice agents and translating business requirements into agent workflows.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience working with enterprise customers and cross\-functional technical teams.
* Ability to manage multiple implementations and drive projects to completion.

**Preferred**

* Experience with AI, conversational AI, voice, contact center, or telephony solutions.
* Experience with healthcare EHR/PMS platforms.
* Experience with UAT and enterprise go\-live processes.

**Why You’ll Join Us**


At Birdeye, we are relentless innovators driven by a singular goal: to lead our category with unparalleled excellence. We don't just set goals – we surpass them. We're a team of doers who roll up our sleeves and get the job done, delivering on our promises with unwavering dedication.


Working here means embracing a culture of action and accountability, where every person is empowered to make an impact. We don't just talk about making a difference – we make it happen.

**Benefits**

* 100% Employer\-paid benefit plans available for employees with multiple health plan options (HSA, PPO)
* Flexible PTO
* 401(k) with company match
* Flexible work from home options available
* Maternity \& Paternity Leave
* Employee Resource Groups \- network with like\-minded "Birds"
* Abundant opportunities that come with a dynamic and fast\-growing organization!

jobs.description:
Praxis Health is looking for a **Clinical Systems Training Specialist** who builds and delivers the education clinic staff and providers need to work effectively in Praxis Health's clinical systems, with an initial focus on the Oracle Health EHR implementation. The role covers both halves of that work: designing training content and materials and delivering it directly to end users.



The role works closely with the Clinical Systems Manager and coordinates with Directors of Operations, RLCMs, and Regional Clinic Provider Leads to schedule training and address workflow readiness.


**Location \& Schedule**


* **Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM
* **Location:** Flexible hybrid schedule based on events, meetings, and other business needs.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Design training curriculum and materials for clinical systems, including the Oracle Health EHR, tailored to different clinic roles (providers, front desk, clinical staff).
* Deliver live training sessions, both in person and virtual, for clinic staff and providers.
* Develop and maintain quick reference guides, job aids, and other supporting training materials.
* Support go\-live and cutover activities for the Oracle Health EHR implementation, including at\-the\-elbow support during go\-live periods.
* Identify training gaps by working with clinic staff, providers, and the Clinical Systems Specialists on recurring issues that point to a training need rather than a system issue.
* Develop and deliver training on new technology and system updates as they roll out, working with the Clinical Systems Specialists to translate technical changes into end\-user education.
* Design and adapt training for AI\-enabled clinic tools, including ambient documentation and AI scribes, as adoption changes clinical workflows and how staff document.
* Coordinate training scheduling with Directors of Operations and RLCMs to minimize disruption to clinic operations.
* Gather and incorporate feedback from training sessions to improve future sessions and materials.
* Champion innovative approaches to training and education, using new tools and methods to make learning clinical systems more effective for staff and providers.
* Partner with Clinical Revenue Cycle, Population Health, Consumer Experience, and other departments to provide continuing education to end users as appropriate.


**What You Bring**


* Comfortable both designing training content and delivering it live to a range of audiences, from providers to front desk staff.
* Strong communication and facilitation skills; able to adapt teaching style to different roles and comfort levels with technology.
* Organized and able to manage a training schedule across multiple clinics and regions.
* Comfortable identifying training gaps by distinguishing recurring issues that point to a training need from those that point to a system issue.
* Champions innovative approaches to training and education, using new tools and methods to make learning clinical systems more effective for staff and providers.
* Comfortable gathering and incorporating feedback from training sessions to improve future sessions and materials.

  


**Required Qualifications**


* 3 to 5 years of experience in training or education, ideally in a clinical or healthcare setting.
* Experience training clinical or healthcare staff on an EHR or other clinical system.
* Demonstrated ability to design training curriculum and materials tailored to different roles, not only deliver existing content.
* Experience developing and maintaining supporting training materials such as quick reference guides and job aids.
* Ability to coordinate training scheduling with operational stakeholders across multiple sites or regions.
* Experience building or establishing a training program from the ground up that has proven durable through subsequent system or organizational changes.

  


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience with Cerner or Oracle Health.
* Exposure to AI tools in a healthcare setting; experience training staff on AI scribes or ambient documentation a plus.


**About Our Company**



Praxis Health is a family of medical groups providing high\-quality healthcare throughout the state of Oregon. Our community\-based clinics are the DNA of our business, providing better medicine, advocacy for our patients, and a satisfying and collaborative culture for our providers and staff. The Praxis family approach is dynamically different from other healthcare companies in Oregon. We are not "big box" health care, but rather a company of small groups and clinics, of nimble micro\-cultures that can quickly adapt to industry changes, as well as patient needs. We have been serving communities across the beautiful and adventurous state of Oregon for over 50 years! And we are pioneers and thought leaders in the industry. Our commitment to innovative and operational excellence has allowed us to create healthcare solutions that are both cost\-efficient and cutting edge. Come see how healthcare is done right!


**General Physical Requirements**



Manual dexterity for office machine operation including computer and calculator; stooping, bending to handle files and supplies, mobility to complete errands for deliveries, or sitting for extended periods of time. The employee must regularly lift and /or move up to 10 pounds, frequently lift and/or move up to 25 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. Stress can be triggered by multiple staff demands and deadlines.

**Job Title:**

Information Technology Training Specialist 1
**Department:**
---------------


Optometry \| Academics
The Ohio State University College of Optometry seeks a temporary Health Systems Administration Transition \& Training Consultant to provide specialized knowledge transfer and transition support following the departure of the College's Health Systems Administration Analyst.


The primary purpose of this temporary assignment is to facilitate the successful transition of Compulink EHR administration and management. Sharing of knowledge and training on the processes, procedures, and technical practices to the employee assuming responsibility for these functions. The consultant will work with the incoming employee, the Associate Dean for Clinical Services, and College IT leadership to provide training, orientation, documentation, and transition support based on established Compulink EHR systems, processes, and workflows.


***This is a temporary transition and training assignment*** . ***Work will be virtual and is expected to average approximately 6 hours per week, as needed, and hours may vary based on the needs of the transition. Work may not be required every week.***

The assignment is intended solely to support knowledge transfer, training, documentation, and transition activities associated with the clinic EHR administration functions. ***The assignment will conclude no later than November 26, 2026, unless ended earlier by the College.***

The consultant is not expected to assume the full scope of ongoing responsibilities associated with the former full\-time Health Systems Administration Analyst position.


The Health Systems Administration Transition \& Training Consultant will provide specialized training and knowledge transfer related to the College of Optometry's Compulink EHR environment and systems administration functions.


The consultant will:


* Provide one\-on\-one and/or small\-group virtual training to the incoming health systems administration employee on College\-specific systems, technology environments, processes, procedures, and workflows.
* Transfer institutional and technical knowledge necessary for the incoming employee to assume responsibility for health systems administration functions.
* Explain existing systems configurations, dependencies, integrations, support processes, and operational considerations relevant to the clinic’s EHR technology environment.
* Demonstrate established procedures for system monitoring, maintenance, troubleshooting, upgrades, security practices, and related systems administration activities, as appropriate.
* Provide orientation to relevant College, University, and technology\-partner relationships, including key contacts, escalation procedures, vendors, and support resources.
* Review existing documentation and identify areas where additional clarification or documentation would support a successful transition.
* Develop or update transition documentation, job aids, process guides, system reference materials, and other resources needed by the incoming employee.

jobs.description:
Overview:

The Epic Application Analyst understands system build and functionality, ability to analyze and understand business workflows and the knowledge to make solution recommendations that meet organizational goals. The primary responsibilities of an Epic Application Analyst are to collaborate with end users of the system to evaluate, design, build, test, train, implement within Epic and other third\-party solutions. The Epic Application Analyst demonstrates excellent customer service performance in in that his/her attitude and actions are at all times consistent with the standards contained in the Vision, Mission and Values of Covenant, and the commitment to Extraordinary Care for Every Generation.


Responsibilities:
* Demonstrates functional knowledge of Epic, applicable third\-party solutions, and Microsoft suite of products.
* Builds and maintains collaborative relationships with customers; meets with customers to capture business \& technical requirement needs.
* Demonstrates knowledge of processes within the business lines supported, assesses workflow methods, identifies gaps, determines necessary workflow changes, and develops workflows alongside customers related to the implementation of new solutions or functionality.
* Designs, builds, and configures within assigned Epic system modules and any supporting third\-party solutions; develops and maintains process documentation using appropriate tools.
* Develops and maintains test scripts for workflow testing; performs testing per department requirements.
* Ensures that application changes and upgrades are working properly.
* Follows departmental standards for change control and quality assurance; provides documentation on system changes and provides training, if applicable.
* Troubleshoots issues and initiates escalation procedures with minimal supervision and provides proposals for resolution of the issues found.
* Participates in or leads cross\-functional projects; Understands project planning and coordination methods using project management tools and skills. Communicates project status of deliverables, barriers (as applicable), end\-user concerns, and upcoming milestones.
* Actively participates in meetings, as needed.
* Provides status updates on work to leadership.
* May be expected to rotate on\-call with other team members to provide 24x7 emergency support for the department and may be expected to provide remote support, if needed.
* Other duties as assigned.


Qualifications:

EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS

* Associate’s degree required.
* Bachelor’s degree preferred.
* 2 years Healthcare, IT or finance/account receivable experience required. Specific experience in the operational area for Epic application preferred.
* In lieu of Associate’s degree, a minimum of two (2\) years Healthcare, IT or finance/account receivable experience in field required and willing to obtain an Associate’s degree within three (3\) years.
* Must become and maintain Vendor certification in specified application within 6\-months of attending first Vendor course.

  

KNOWLEDGE/SKILLS/ABILITIES

* Must have a strong working knowledge of departmental policies, procedures, business operations and workflows with an understanding of how they interrelate to other departments in the organization.
* Previous experience in area of application preferred.
* Strong computing skills including a working knowledge of Word, Excel, Power Point, Visio, web browsing, issue tracking and email applications and/or a willingness to learn.
* Strong project management skills including the ability to lead meetings, prioritize, resolve conflicts, and maintain issues lists.
* Must demonstrate a positive and enthusiastic attitude.
* Must be a team player with the ability to work independently as well as in small or large teams.
* Demonstrates the ability to resolve problems timely and effectively.
* Must be detail oriented and have a skill for probing for information in order to fully understand the underlying needs that drive how the system should be built.
* Must be approachable and have the ability to deal positively with employees at all levels of the organization.
* Protects and maintains the confidential nature of information.
* Ability to consistently meet assigned deadlines for projects.
* Demonstrated effective follow\-up activities.
* Sound decision making ability.
* Ability to multitask.
* Ability to accept and adapt to change.
* May be asked to mentor/coach new IT employees.
* Strong ability for self\-direction.

  

WORKING CONDITIONS/PHYSICAL DEMANDS

* Frequent standing, walking, sitting, handling, feeling, talking, hearing and near vision.
* Occasional lifting 0\-10 lbs.
* Occasional reclining, lifting, carrying, pushing, pulling, climbing, balancing, stooping, kneeling, crouching, squatting, crawling, twisting, reaching, far vision and depth perception.

**Why Work at Covenant HealthCare**
At Covenant HealthCare, we are united by a shared mission of providing Extraordinary Care for Every Generation. We foster a culture built on teamwork, excellence, accountability, respect, customer service, and enthusiasm, where every employee plays an important role in delivering patient\-centered care and making a difference in our community.**Our benefits include:*** Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
* Retirement plans with employer match
* Paid time off to support work\-life balance
* Employee wellness programs and mental health support
* Tuition reimbursement, university discounts, and professional development opportunities

**How to Apply**
Submit your resume and any required documents with your application. A resume is required.
Applicants will receive confirmation that their application has been received. Candidate updates will be provided via email, text message, or phone call.

Thrive is a rapidly growing technology solutions provider focusing upon Cloud, Cyber Security, Networking, Disaster Recovery and Managed Services. Our corporate culture, engineering talent, customer\-centric approach, and focus upon “next generation” services help us stand out amongst our peers. Thrive is on the look\-out for individuals who don’t view their weekdays spent at “a job” but rather look to develop valuable skills that ignite their passion and lead to a CAREER. If you’re attracted to a “work hard, play hard” environment, seeking the guidance, training and experience necessary to build a lucrative career, then welcome to THRIVE!!

  

Position Overview

  

A Voice Implementation Specialist is responsible for completing telephony projects for new and existing clients. This position’s primary objective is to complete customer project goals as defined within Thrive project plans, orders and scopes of service. A Voice Implementation Specialist will work with Vendors, other Engineers, Project Managers and Thrive clients to accomplish those goals and objectives for successful rollouts of Thrive Voice Solutions.

  

Responsibilities

* Implementation of IT projects related (but not limited to) the following:
* Implementation of Teams Voice
* Manage Number porting Process
* Audit and Maintain telephony inventory
* Serve as a liaison with Carriers
* Work through the project process to reach a successful outcome by:
* Coordinate porting processes with carriers, internal stakeholders and clients
* Maintain documentation of porting activities, contracts, circuit orders, and carrier communications.
* Working at direction of Implementation Management and Project Managers to complete tasks in adherence to a formal project plan.
* Assisting in completion of Support Handoff requirements to allow for long term maintenance by Thrive Service Desk
* Clearly and professionally communicate porting timelines, and testing procedures to customers.
* Track and manage time effectively to accomplish multiple ongoing projects.

 **Requirements**  

Qualifications

  

Minimum


* Strong understanding of LNP (Local Number Portability) processes and carrier service contracts.
* 2\-4\+ years' experience working with telephony carriers.
* Proven ability to manage timelines and communicate across cross functional teams and external vendors to ensure successful service delivery.
* Basic Knowledge of Traditional Telephony; E911 regulations, telecom billing, contracts, and number assignment best practices.
* Familiarity with modern VoIP systems, Teams/8x8 strongly preferred


Preferred


* Experience using ServiceNow (or other project management software)
* Experience in ITIL methodology and change management processes
* Willingness to improve team process and contribute to team and company initiatives

jobs.title: Retail Training Specialist
jobs.description:
At Curaleaf, we're redefining the cannabis industry with a strong commitment to quality, expertise, and innovation. As a leading global cannabis provider, our brands—including Curaleaf, Select, and Grassroots—offer premium products and services in both medical and adult\-use markets.



Join us at Curaleaf to be part of a high\-growth, purpose\-driven company that champions corporate social responsibility through our *Rooted in Good* initiative, supporting community outreach and positive change. Here, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact, drive innovation, and help shape the future of cannabis.

**Retail Training Specialist**  

**Location: Tampa, FL**  

**The candidate in this role will be required to travel 50\-70% of the time throughout the North Florida/Tampa region and will be working on\-site when not traveling.**  

**Compensation is negotiable and will be based on qualifications and experience.**


**About the Role:**



Are you passionate about training others and making a real impact at the store level? Join Curaleaf as a Retail Training Specialist and help shape the guest experience across our retail footprint. In this field\-based role, you'll bring national training strategies to life by supporting Store and District Managers through hands\-on coaching, engaging facilitation, and performance\-driven insights. You'll be the critical connection between our learning programs and the customer experience, driving consistency, elevating performance, and fueling growth from the ground up.


**What You'll Do:**


* Be a champion of Curaleaf's culture, mission, values, and products, and share that energy with every team you train.
* Deliver in\-store and virtual training sessions that focus on product knowledge, guest experience, and sales strategies.
* Reinforce training through regular store visits, live coaching, and on\-the\-floor support, helping teams turn learning into action.
* Collaborate closely with Store and District Managers to identify development opportunities and offer scalable, practical training solutions.
* Build strong, positive relationships with store teams, field leaders, and senior stakeholders to ensure training translates into real performance outcomes.
* Facilitate the rollout of our national training curriculum for both new and existing store teams.
* Support cross\-functional initiatives by partnering with other departments to ensure our training content stays fresh, relevant, and aligned with business goals.
* Track and report on training effectiveness, offering feedback to continuously improve our programs.
* Contribute to operational excellence by optimizing training delivery and helping drive revenue through best\-in\-class retail practices.
* Travel extensively (50–70%) to support teams across the country — this role is for someone who thrives on the move.
* Pitch in on other training and development duties as needed — we're a team that supports each other.


**What You'll Bring:**


* A tenacious, curious mindset \- you're flexible, adaptable, and always eager to learn.
* Experience thriving in fast\-paced, high\-energy retail environments where priorities shift quickly.
* At least 3 years of hands\-on experience in store operations, retail training, or leadership development.
* At least 2 years of experience as a Retail Store Manager.
* The ability to collaborate, influence, and build alignment across departments — even when navigating competing priorities.
* A calm, confident, and solutions\-oriented approach, especially when things get hectic.
* A people\-first attitude with a natural ability to build trust through clear, honest communication.
* Strong interpersonal and coaching skills, you know how to connect with team members at every level and inspire action.
* An entrepreneurial spirit and a strategic mindset, you don't just follow the playbook, you help rewrite it.
* Self\-starter energy with strong time management and organizational chops.
* A coachable mindset with a genuine desire to grow the brand by developing and empowering others.
* Impeccable attention to detail and the ability to stay organized while supporting teams nationwide.
* Solid tech skills \- you're comfortable with Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams)


**Even Better If You Have:**


* Experience working with learning management systems (LMS) or training platforms like Cornerstone.
* Experience with tools like Tableau or PowerBI


**Physical Requirements:**



While performing the duties of this Job, the employee is regularly required to walk, sit, stand, talk or hear, use hands to finger or feel, and reach with hands and arms. The employee is occasionally required to climb and balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl, and lift up to 50 lbs.



This position has allergen warnings \- Potential exposure to dust, pollen, and plant pathogens and requires a high\-stress tolerance, adaptability, and flexibility. Ability to work in an ever\-changing environment.

 **What We Offer:**


* Career Growth Opportunities
* Competitive Pay and Benefits
* Generous PTO and Parental Leave
* 401(K) Retirement Plan
* Life/ Disability Insurance
* Community Involvement
* Referral Bonuses and Product Discounts


*Benefits vary by state, role type, and eligibility.*

**Follow us on Social Media:**  

Instagram: @curaleaf.usa  

Twitter: @Curaleaf\_Inc  

LinkedIn: Curaleaf LinkedIn



Curaleaf Holdings, Inc. (TSX: CURA) (OTCQX: CURLF) ("Curaleaf") is a leading international provider of consumer products in cannabis with a mission to enhance lives by cultivating, sharing, and celebrating the power of the plant. As a high\-growth cannabis company known for quality, expertise and reliability, the Company, and its brands, including Curaleaf, Select, Grassroots, Find, and Anthem provide industry\-leading service, product selection and accessibility across the medical and adult\-use markets. Curaleaf International is powered by a strong presence in all stages of the supply chain. Its unique distribution network throughout Europe, Canada and Australasia brings together pioneering science and research with cutting\-edge cultivation, extraction and production. Home \| Curaleaf \| Cannabis with Confidence


**Our Vision:** To be the world's leading cannabis company by consistently delivering superior products and services and driving the global acceptance of cannabis.


**Our Values:**


* Lead and Inspire.
* Commit to Win.
* ONE Curaleaf.
* Driven to Deliver Excellence.

Curaleaf is an equal opportunity employer. Curaleaf recruits, employs, trains, compensates, and promotes regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, physical ability, age, veteran status, and other protected status as required by applicable law.



We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.



Individuals adversely impacted by the war on drugs are encouraged to apply.

Although Curaleaf operates in states that have legalized and decriminalized marijuana, it is still considered a controlled substance under federal regulations and thus illegal under federal law.
